fixed.problem: D7-3/SC-1/SC-2: chat could not ask the agent to fix its tasks. Now 'fix the tasks', 'tidy up the task list', 'check the tasks', 'räum die Aufgaben auf', 'korrigiere die Aufgaben' (intent.ts fixTasksAskOf; never a line naming one task) run one task check with no chat-model call first. The chat model gets a fix_tasks tool (definition FIX_TASKS_DESCRIPTION, parameter project only) and CHAT_TASK_RULES in the stable system part. task_split is a chat tool again.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/commands/test/intent.test.ts "d1109-selftasks-chat, run C: 'fix the tasks' (SC-1)"; packages/runtime/test/chat-fix-tasks.test.ts (whole file)
fixed.how: conversation/task-fix-tool.ts fixTasksInChat runs runTaskCheck, fenceTaskChanges and then applyTaskChanges or one composed read-back through CommandLoop.planFix. agent.ts adds the parser branch, the tool registration and CHAT_TASK_RULES. The person's line is passed verbatim (at most 500 characters) in its own data envelope. The task check's rules get a chat variant of the first paragraph (task-check@1.1.0). compose wires ConversationDeps.taskCheck from the runner's deps. The bench stand-in reads the request lines.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Project at Standard with plan-written tasks > Chat tab > type 'fix the tasks: "Style the page" is two jobs, the layout and the colours; nothing checks that the links work.' > the waiting line says 'Checking the tasks of <project>…' > the reply is 'I changed 2 tasks of <project>.' with one row and one Undo per change, and the line under it is 'Checking the tasks cost ... CHF'. Live check 4: with the real model, see that it returns strict JSON and that a split carries every criterion. Also ask in other words ('can you tidy the task list up?'), check that the model calls fix_tasks and that the check's message holds your line verbatim (model-call log).

fixed.problem: D7-4b/SC-3: in chat the project's autonomy never decided. Now from Standard each change is made at once as the agent's (source chat, the person's words, one Undo each, no Inbox line). At Advisor and Assisted, when the fence asks first, or after a lookup returned records (recordsRead), the set is one read-back with Yes and No. A Yes after a daemon restart makes it with no second check.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/chat-fix-tasks.test.ts 'at Standard ...', 'at Assisted ...', 'a Yes after a restart ...', 'after a lookup returned records ...'; apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts describe 'd1109-selftasks-chat, run C' (POST /chat at Standard and at Assisted with the restart)
fixed.how: executor: planFix below Standard, or planFix.askFirst, always reads back. StoredCardContext keeps planFix, so a restored card is decided and told as before. compose(..., {ask}) gives a composed card its own question, kept for a restart. CommandLoop.planFix builds the planFix context in code.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Set the project to Assisted > Chat 'fix the tasks' > one yellow read-back 'Make these N changes to the tasks of <project>? ...' with Yes and No, and one card in the Inbox > quit and restart Forerunner within 10 minutes > answer Yes > the changes are made as one row with one Undo, and the model-call log shows no second task-check call. At Standard on tasks you added yourself, it asks once and the line under it says 'Asks you first: "X" is a task you added or changed yourself.'

fixed.problem: SC-4/SC-14: money and the credential policy. The check is booked to the project, with its cost in CHF under the reply. A check that would pass the project's budget or the monthly cap makes no call ('Fixing the tasks would pass this project's budget; nothing changed.'). A second request while one runs reads 'The agent is checking the tasks of <project> now; ask again in a moment.' Under subscription_then_wait or an unanswered then_ask, with the subscription at its limit, no call is made, nothing is booked, no task changes, and chat says 'Fixing the tasks waits for Claude: your subscription is at its limit until 15:40. Nothing changed.' Under then_key the check runs once on the key, with its cost in CHF. Without Claude: 'Fixing the tasks needs Claude.'
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/credential-policy.test.ts "d1109-selftasks-chat, run C: 'fix the tasks' follows the one policy (SC-14)" (3 cases); chat-fix-tasks.test.ts 'no room', 'busy', 'without Claude'
fixed.how: fixTasksInChat checks taskCheckRunning, chatRoom and runTaskCheck's not_made reasons (no_provider, no_room, held with its wait, worded through the exported shortStoppedPhrase). It runs under withTaskCheckLock. Its sentences are in conversation/sentences.ts.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Settings > Which Claude does the work > subscription first, then wait. Let the subscription reach its limit (ask a question that meets it). Chat 'fix the tasks' > the reply is 'Fixing the tasks waits for Claude: your subscription is at its limit until HH:MM. Nothing changed.', Costs has no new row, and the tasks are unchanged.

fixed.problem: D7-3/SC-5: one turn that called several task tools read back the first and left the others as Yes/No cards in the Inbox. Now they are one question naming them all and one card. Yes makes them as one row with one Undo.
fixed.how: CommandLoop.recompose marks the separate pending rows chat_only, cancels them, and composes their calls into one card. The agent's results loop calls it for 2 or more pending task.* results. mergeCards and the executor's questionOf use oneQuestion: 'A, b and c?'.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Chat (model path) 'Publish the page is urgent and should not wait on anything.' > one read-back 'Change "Publish the page": priority to High and let "Publish the page" run without waiting for another task?' > the Inbox has one card for it > Yes > one row on Changes with one Undo.

fixed.check_in_the_app: Project at Standard, a task 'Create the page' whose report says '"Style the page" is two jobs' (bench: FORERUNNER_BENCH_TASK_LIST), and Style waiting for a person task > Start > open the session page > the 'Split ...' line has Undo > restart Forerunner > Undo is still there > click it > the line reads 'Undone: "Style the page" is one task again.'

fix_tasks, task_split and CHAT_TASK_RULES ride on every turn. They are measured as sent and taken off, as earlier areas' additions are, so the bound keeps its intent.

tests_changed_for_design.test: packages/runtime/test/conversation.test.ts tool names and 'a combined request is one change card'
tests_changed_for_design.why: fix_tasks is an allowed tool name. A composed card is now one question ('Switch to PharmaWatch and raise ...?'), not two (SC-5).
SC-9: the changes are an open list (request-details-open), not under Details.
SC-12: 'Added by the agent' replaces 'created by agent <id> via chat' (no id or channel). The agent-as-actor intent is kept.

new_problems: A chat read-back card waits 10 minutes (PENDING_TTL_MS). After a later restart it has expired, so 'a Yes after a restart' holds only within that window (real-daemon case restarts on the same clock start). Whether the read-back should live longer is the session lead's decision.

Bench walk: chat model tool calls (actor agent, source chat, no planFix) still post an Inbox info line after the person's Yes (executor.post: not theirOwn). This is pre-existing for every model-issued command. fix_tasks avoids it through planFix.

The conversation's 'Note for the next session' textbox is the last textbox on the Overview. A walk script that typed into getByRole('textbox').last() saved a note there (not an app bug, but the Chat tab is not reachable by ?tab=chat).
notes_for_other_areas: ConversationCommands gains optional planFix(changes, turn, {level, readBack, askFirst?, ask?}) and recompose(pendingIds, turn) (CommandLoop implements both). The planFix context is built only there.

CommandContext.planFix gains askFirst?: boolean. The executor reads back every change of a planFix context below Standard or with askFirst. StoredCardContext keeps planFix for restorePending. executor.compose(calls, ctx, {ask}) gives a composed card its own question, restored after a restart.
change-card.ts exports oneQuestion. mergeCards' ask is now one question ('A, b and c?'). Any later area that composes cards gets one-question read-backs.

EventView (append-only): changeId, undoable, undoBlocked, undone on 'change' lines (GET /sessions/:id/events JSON and SSE). ChangeLogView.byAgent. RequestView.openDetails (RequestWords.openDetails in request-words.ts).

ConversationDeps.taskCheck (the runner's TaskCheckDeps, compose's taskCheckDeps). TaskCheckDeps.model may return a Promise. taskCheckRules/taskCheckSystem take {fromChat} and TASK_CHECK_PROMPT_VERSION is task-check@1.1.0.

Sentences for the session lead's words list (conversation/sentences.ts): 'I changed 3 tasks of Quote page.'; 'Make these 3 changes to the tasks of Quote page? …'; 'The tasks of Quote page look right; nothing changed.'; 'Checking the tasks of Quote page…'; 'Fixing the tasks needs Claude.'; 'Fixing the tasks would pass this project's budget; nothing changed.' (and '… your monthly cap …'); 'The agent is checking the tasks of Quote page now; ask again in a moment.'; 'Which project: A or B?'; 'Fixing the tasks waits for Claude: your subscription is at its limit until 15:40. Nothing changed.'; 'Checking the tasks cost CHF 0.03.'; 'Asks you first: "X" is a task you added or changed yourself.'; Changes 'In a session'; session page 'Cannot be undone now: …'.

Owner question default built (one place): 'Fix the tasks' is chat only (and the agent's own check during a run), no Tasks-tab button. A button would call POST /chat with the line or a new route over fixTasksInChat.

d1109-cred-screens (C6 sibling): SessionPage.tsx changed only in the log line (ChangeUndo after the line's text), and InboxPage.tsx only in the details block (openDetails). GET /sessions/:id/events, not GET /sessions/:id, carries the log line fields.
